title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 21: the evil reign of Manasseh, Yahweh's word against Jerusalem and the short reign of Amon.

questions.text: How old was Manasseh when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Manasseh raised up altars for Baal and made an Asherah as which king had done?
questions.explanation: He raised up altars for Baal and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did.

questions.text: Where did Manasseh build altars for all the army of the sky?
questions.explanation: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh's house.

answers.text: In the two courts of Yahweh's house
On the roof of the king's palace
In the valley outside the city

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen to whoever hears of the evil he would bring on Jerusalem and Judah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle."

questions.text: How did Yahweh say he would wipe Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down."

answers.text: As the wind blows away the chaff
As a man wipes a dish, turning it upside down
As a flood washes away a house on sand
As a fire burns up the dry stubble

questions.text: With what did Manasseh fill Jerusalem from one end to another?
questions.explanation: Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another.
Manasseh was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza.

answers.text: In David's city with the kings

questions.text: How long did Amon reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
The servants of Amon conspired against him and put the king to death in his own house.

answers.text: His servants put him to death in his own house
He was killed in battle against Egypt
He was carried away to Babylon

questions.text: Whom did the people of the land make king after Amon?
questions.explanation: The people of the land killed the conspirators and made Josiah his son king in his place.
